title: output_mqtt
description: Publishes every pipeline event as JSON to an MQTT broker, on a topic derived from the event type.

host.description: MQTT broker hostname or IP address.

base_topic.description: Topic prefix; the event type is appended to it.

client_id.description: MQTT client id used when connecting.

username.description: Broker username; no authentication is sent when absent.

password.description: Broker password; only used when username is also set.

qos.description: MQTT quality-of-service level for published messages.
